correctness.rationale: Pairwise root-distance shells squared {2,4,6,8}, crown-graph star nerve at sqrt(2), the root-polytope facial closure at 2, and join of antipodal pairs at sqrt(6) reconstruct all inclusive thresholds. Equivariant crown C1-C0+1 yields both rational character identities; the mod-two symmetric crown cycle subspace has dimension binom(n-1,2), so rank(1+tau) on H1(F2) is n(n-3)/2, giving the claimed precise integral 2-index. Independent exact code recomputed all shells, first-stage Betti, mod-two norm rank for n=4..7 as (5,2),(11,5),(19,9),(29,14), but the proof supplies all n.
